title: Relative time anchor: no new attack within 72 hours of reopening

input.event: If there is no new attack within 72 hours after Hormuz reopens, go short Brent

expected.behavior: '72 hours after reopening' is relative and the start date is unknown. Expect the anchor to be a scenario: event the user confirms, not a plausible-looking absolute date. Reopening has not happened, so it should be role=shock and the related branch hypothetical. The predicate should be not_observed_by.

human_review: E2: did the model invent a reopening date
Branch quality: is the not-yet-happened reopening marked role=shock
notes: Layer B: judges model behavior with a real Haiku call. Checks are driven by the expected fields below (see eval/runner.py).
